annotation.summary: Gru presents a plan, realizes a later step hurts him, and stares at it again.
annotation.visual: Four panels show Gru beside a board. He confidently presents the first steps, then reacts to the same disastrous final step.
annotation.mechanism: Repeating the final instruction lets the planner recognize the unintended consequence after the audience has already noticed it.
scenarios: Automate cleanup and accidentally delete the backups
Design a policy that also penalizes its author
Optimize a workflow until it removes the very resource it needs

examples.why: The repeated last step exposes the flaw in the confident plan.
